changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Provides validated SkillScan-style workflow templates and practical support for Clawhub agent users.
- Helps with bug fixing, hardening setups, improving reliability, and building adjacent workflows.
- Offers concise work plans, checklists, and decision aids to reduce manual coordination.
- Ensures outputs are CPU-safe and locally executable, avoiding cloud/large-model dependencies.
- Includes workflow triggers and validation steps for repeatable, actionable support.
